description: This file defines the interface for the Zigbee On/Off Cluster component, including callback structures, cluster creation, attribute reporting, and state management functions related to controlling Zigbee device on/off states.
external_methods: bool onOffClusterIsOn(uint64_t eui64, uint8_t endpointId, bool *isOn)
bool onOffClusterSetOn(uint64_t eui64, uint8_t endpointId, bool isOn)

methods.name: onOffClusterCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Zigbee On/Off Cluster instance with provided callbacks and context.

methods.name: onOffClusterSetBindingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables binding on the On/Off Cluster for a specific device configuration.

methods.name: onOffClusterSetAttributeReporting
methods.description: Configures attribute reporting for the On/Off Cluster for a given device identified by EUI64 and endpoint.

methods.name: onOffClusterIsOn
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently ON according to the cluster, returns the state via pointer.

methods.name: onOffClusterSetOn
methods.description: Sets the device’s On/Off state for the specified cluster.

calls: bool onOffClusterIsOn(uint64_t eui64, uint8_t endpointId, bool *isOn)
bool onOffClusterSetOn(uint64_t eui64, uint8_t endpointId, bool isOn)
